message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate crime label(s) based on facts.

Facts: Defendant Zhang cut down oil pine trees (油松) that belong to village collective (集体所有). He used hand saw to cut them, placed on site or took home for fire, also planted fruit trees. The assessment shows 288 stumps, volume 10 cubic meters. This is illegal logging of collective forest resources. The appropriate crime: According to Chinese criminal law, "非法采伐、毁坏森林资源" vs "盗伐林木". The correction lessons include:

- Correct label 【盗伐林木】 (not “非法采伐、毁坏森林资源”). It says: 关键在于行为是未经授权砍伐、占有集体所有的树木，属于盗伐林木；而“非法采伐、毁坏森林资源”侧重于破坏森林资源的行为，不一定涉及占有.

Thus the correct label is 盗伐林木.

Check if any other crimes apply: maybe also "非法占用农用地"? No, it's forest land. Not "职务侵占". Not "破坏生产经营". So single label: 盗伐林木.

Thus output: [罪名]盗伐林木<eoa>
